lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of change (adoption/notification, choose_path/hint, home/new_flow, sign_in/incentive) because each has only been tested once.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after pet adoption
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen to after pet selection and adoption certificates so users customize their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and sign_in has drop-off; placing sign-in after adoption leverages user investment in their pet.

sign_in.headline: Save your new pet to your account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to keep your companion synced across your desktop devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off steps (adoption 60.9%, sign_in 72.9%), but requires flow restructuring.

candidates.title: Interactive pet controls quickstart guide
candidates.change: Add a visual controls guide screen at the finish step demonstrating how to drag, right-click, hide, and talk to your pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple complaints about users not knowing how to control or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step median time is 395s.

new_pet_controls_guide.headline: How to interact with your pet
new_pet_controls_guide.body: Drag your pet anywhere on desktop, right-click for options, or double-click to open chat.

components.text: Right-click your pet at any time to hide or adjust settings.

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive guide screen after home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% and support mails confirm user confusion; requires a new screen.

candidates.title: Interactive stage preview redesign for adoption certificate
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate into a live stage preview showing an animated pet with real-time name input.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point (60.9%) and support reported issues with pet generation failing or looking wrong.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Animated waiting screen mini-game flow
candidates.change: Insert an interactive treat-tossing mini-game screen while background pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing user drop-off while waiting for pet assets to load.

new_waiting_game.headline: Play while you wait
new_waiting_game.body: Toss treats to your pet companion while background setup finishes.

components.text: Your pet will appear on your desktop as soon as setup completes!

guard.reason: Adding a waiting screen mini-game sub-flow within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time, but new_flow tests previously showed negative lift (-0.9%).

candidates.title: Account pet persistence hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a hint explaining that signing in with the same email restores existing adopted pets and saved progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your existing account email restores your adopted pets and desktop settings automatically.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Desktop placement instruction on finish intro
candidates.change: Update the home intro text to explain exactly where the pet will land on screen and how to wake it up.
candidates.why: 3 support emails noted pet not showing up on desktop, and the finish step conversion is 64.8% with mean time over 5800s.

home_intro.headline: Your pet is live on your desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom right corner of your screen. Click your pet to start interacting immediately.

guard.reason: Updating text and button copy on the home_intro screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 3 support emails and finish metrics; cheap text-only change.

candidates.title: Tip carousel and progress percentage bar on waiting screen
candidates.change: Show an active progress percentage bar and rotating feature tips on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading users to believe the application froze.

components.text: Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on desktop by clicking and dragging.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and carousel tips to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high home wait time (median 201s) with low-overhead UI components.

candidates.title: Two-column choice overview layout for onboarding path
candidates.change: Switch choose_path screen to a two-column comparison layout side-by-side.
candidates.why: Choose path takes mean 514s and drops 23.2% of users; side-by-side options speed up decision making.

choose_path.headline: How would you like to start?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play template or create a fully customized companion pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path into a two-column layout while offering both options is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Modest drop-off step (23.2%); choose_path tweaks previously showed positive lift (+2.5%).

candidates.title: Background system tray notification option on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable desktop tray notifications so users can minimize the app during pet generation.
candidates.why: Pet generation wait mean time is 2336s; users tab away and forget to return to complete setup.

waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding notification options to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times, but notification changes previously performed poorly (-1.6%).

candidates.title: Free starter pet item bundle badge on pick friend screen
candidates.change: Display a prominent starter toy and food bundle reward badge on the friend selection screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel at 60.9% conversion.

components.text: Includes Free Starter Toy Pack & Treats

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free' starter items and extras, violating pricing copy rules.

picked: Tip carousel and progress percentage bar on waiting screen
Two-column choice overview layout for onboarding path

decisions.title: Tip carousel and progress percentage bar on waiting screen
Two-column choice overview layout for onboarding path
